ideas.title: After Hours (working title): Roblox horror pilots
ideas.logline: Standalone suspense stories with Max, Mia and Leo: an unlisted player copies them across an empty server, a duplicate-player encounter and a night shift.
ideas.notes: Working name, entity and pilot premises are not approved scripts; no videos produced. First pass of the asset kit built and reviewed 2026-10-02 (see the build status in the asset plan).

ideas.title: The Free Coin Trap
ideas.logline: Max finds a free-coin button, holds it down, and gets buried until Mia pays one coin to stop it.

ideas.title: The AFK Champion
ideas.logline: Leo is AFK for five rounds of a disaster-survival game and keeps surviving by accident until Max and Mia try to get him kicked.

ideas.title: Admin For One Round
ideas.logline: Leo gets admin commands for one round, spams a useless 'explode' command, and finds out too late that it was aimed at himself.
ideas.platform: TikTok (>60 s for Creator Rewards) / YouTube Shorts

ideas.title: The AFK Millionaire
ideas.logline: Last one in the circle wins a million coins: Leo, Max and Mia take each other out with tricks while the noob never moves, because he was eating dinner.
ideas.platform: TikTok (>60 s for Creator Rewards) / YouTube Shorts

ideas.title: Max Got Admin For One Round
ideas.logline: Max gets admin and spends the round trying to get rid of Leo; every command backfires, the ban lands one second too late, and next round Leo gets admin again.

ideas.title: ViralRoblox News (daily series)
ideas.logline: Daily 65-75 s Roblox news Short with one recurring girl news presenter, a fixed branded news booth, a fixed cover layout and a 'Follow ViralRobloxGames' call to action every episode.
ideas.platform: TikTok (>60 s for Creator Rewards) / YouTube Shorts

ideas.title: Leo Gave Everyone Admin
ideas.logline: Leo means to kick everyone but types admin all; an admin war breaks out (explode, invisible-with-floating-hair, giant, rocket) while Mia quietly types one long command that strips the boys of admin and makes them dance - but she forgot the AFK noob, who still has admin and just got back from dinner.

ideas.title: The Noob Has Admin
ideas.logline: The noob gets admin and turns out to be a pro who counters everyone's signature moves; Mia never moves all round, Leo pokes her and she falls like a plank, then the noob types gg and it posts under Mia's name - the noob is Mia's alt, so in Part 3 she didn't forget him.

ideas.title: Mia Had Two Crowns
ideas.logline: Leo and Max team up against Mia's two accounts, discover only one can move at a time and overwhelm her; she freezes herself on the wrong window, then typos 'admin Leo and Max' - their alliance lasts one second and they kick each other. Mia wins by accident; Skye joins the game.

ideas.title: The Server Says One
ideas.logline: The server says one player online, but a faceless player stands in front of Max, copying him half a second late. It is his mirror image, and it creeps closer with every copy. Max fakes left, cuts right and slams the EXIT door; the copy, running the wrong way, hits the other side. Then the list updates: two players online. Max. And Max.

ideas.title: Which Max Is Real
ideas.logline: Finale. Mia, who was spectating, realises the copy is a mirror: 'raise your right hand' exposes the right Max (the hoodie star was the clue). It lunges for her; Max walks backwards so the mirror backs toward the EXIT door, it resists one step away, Max sprints backwards and the mirror is flung through; Mia slams the door. Two players online. Max waves goodbye at the door; nothing waves back.

ideas.title: Three Seconds
ideas.logline: Leo can stop time, but only for three seconds, which is never enough. When a piano falls toward Mia and she's twenty steps away, he uses his three seconds to throw the dodgeball that once hit him and knocks her clear. Mia asks if he just stopped time. 'Three seconds is cute. I get four.' She freezes him and eats his fries, which is where they kept going.
ideas.notes: Dropped 2026-10-03: the 'I get four' twist was a last-second new rule and the downside was only 'too short'. Replaced by Forty Floors.

ideas.title: Forty Floors
ideas.logline: You're falling forty floors, and you can swap places with anything alive you can see. Swapping saves you but drops the window cleaner in your place, so you swap back. Everyone in sight would fall instead of you, until you see a pigeon. It takes your fall and opens its wings; the window cleaner you spared lowers his platform and pulls you in.

ideas.title: Which Max Rejoined?
ideas.series: After Hours horror (part 2 of 2, finale v3)
ideas.logline: Two Maxes; the mirror test shows the real one is LEFT. The copy isn't late any more and keeps closing in, so Max makes it copy him leaving the game: both disconnect. Max clicks Rejoin and spawns alone, one player online... then sees the star on his hoodie is on the wrong side. The copy rejoined.

ideas.title: The Last Penalty
ideas.logline: You're the keeper facing the last penalty of the final. Leo always looks at the corner he's aiming for, so you dive early and save it, but it's retaken because you left your line. Knowing he's been read, Leo shuts his eyes, and you stay on your line. Unable to see, he scuffs it into the grass and it rolls to your boot.
